title: "ہو گۓ رخصت جہاں سے مومنوں مولا نقی۴"
language: "Urdu"

kalamType: "Noha"

Hogaye rukhsat jahan se momino Mola Naqi ع
Aaj phir sadaat ke ghar hai saff-e-matam bichi

1
Kat gayi ro ke jawani Sammara ki qaid mein
Yaad kar kar ke aseeri Sayed-e-Sajjad ع ki

2
Sar mein hai khaak-e-yateemi kartay hain matam Hassan ع
Zehar se Baba ki zindaan mein shahadat hogayi

3
Gulshane Aal-e-Nabi par hai udaasi chah gayi
Agaya zad mein fiza ki hai Gul-e-Baagh-e-Taqi ع

4
Pee liya jamay shahadat ay meray dasway Imam
Baksh di Islam ko yun aap ne hai zindagi

5
Ho Naqi ع ke qatilon par har ghari Allah ki lanat
Ban gaye Mola ع ke qatil hashr tak hai lanti

6
Yun uthi Jawad mayyit Shah ki pardes mein
Khud qaza taboot par hai askh barsaati rahi

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/ho-g-rkhst-jhan-se-momnon-mola-nqi.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---\\n',2)[2].strip()
_, yaml, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---\\n',2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert roman == old.replace(' ع','')
blocks = body.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert [len(s.splitlines()) for s in blocks] == [2]+[3]*6
assert [s.splitlines()[0] for s in blocks[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶')
assert '\\u200c' not in body and body.count('ؑ') == old.count('ع')
print('Verified 14 verses, opening and six numbered stanzas, and Roman wording.')
PY

print('Verified matching structure and Urdu honorifics across 14 verses.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and checked that the opening and six numbered stanzas align with `romanLyrics`. The Roman wording is preserved, with honorific marks retained in the Urdu body. I read “Sammara” as سامرہ and “askh” as اشک.

Set the direction to right-to-left, added the Roman alternate title, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag. Only the selected lyric was edited.
